concept.notice: Fictional paper and type workshop / concept edition
concept.description: An invented paper workshop composed from oversized type, flat color and a photograph-free cut paper plate.

blocks.label: 01 / Cut
blocks.caption: Start with a shape. Keep the offcuts.

blocks.label: 02 / Shift
blocks.caption: Move a little. Let the tension show.

collage.marquee: ROUGHEN / PAPER HAS A MEMORY / TYPE HAS A VOICE / MADE TO BE MOVED

copy.title: An imperfect first impression.
copy.deck: An imagined workshop for people who think with their hands. Push the type around. Leave a little evidence.

copy.title: The edges are the beginning.
copy.deck: A circle, a fold, a stubborn strip of paper. Our fictional first edition starts with what another process leaves behind.

copy.title: Give the letters some room to argue.
copy.deck: Heavy meets light. Upright meets slanted. Scale does the talking before a sentence has even begun.

copy.title: Almost in register.
copy.deck: Shift one element by a breath. Watch a tidy arrangement become a composition with a point of view.

copy.title: Keep the useful accident.
copy.deck: Every cutout carries a small instruction. Hover, focus or tap to read the notes. On a phone, every note stays in view.

copy.title: A page with fingerprints.
copy.deck: No photographs, no borrowed marks. Just language, paper color and an SVG study. Roughen is a fictional workshop; this edition is a visual experiment.
